question: Given the current pilot event ledger, generate descriptive chronology, event-date completeness diagnostics, technology-wave counts, self-capability proportions, and a preregistration-ready analysis plan without making confirmatory claims.

method.description: Deterministic pilot diagnostics only. No causal or confirmatory estimation is authorized.
negative_controls: Do not infer clustering from ten seed-coded events.
Do not treat publication date as candidate-generation date unless marked as a proxy.
Do not treat source count as independent confirmation.
sensitivity_tests: Separate aggregate events that may require subevent decomposition.
Report all unresolved date fields and classification uncertainties.
